custom_expected: Office row has lock icon and only eye icon (non-editable). Permission summary matches documented Office target set. Any spec-documented capability change vs legacy (gain or loss) is expected behavior, not a regression.
custom_preconds: Migration complete. At least one legacy Office user exists.
custom_steps:
1. Go to left sidebar > SETTINGS > Staff. Locate a legacy Office user.
2. Confirm assigned role = 'Office'.
3. Go to left sidebar > SETTINGS > Roles & Permissions. Locate 'Office' row.
4. Observe lock icon and Actions column.
5. Click eye icon. View permission summary.
6. Compare against the documented Office target set on the legacy mapping page.
title: Legacy 'Office' users land on system 'Office' role (non-editable)
